tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground under the photo; with the lush gradient it is the photo-fail fallback only. Dark: near-black green.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on glass-fill-strong panels and canvas. Measured ≥12:1 on rendered glass in both themes (primary-text floor 7:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, secondary lines on glass-fill-strong (emerald-950 at 75%; was 60%). Measured ≥6:1 light, ≥8:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary readable text (replaces gray-400/300 and text-faint as text). Light = gray-600.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text and links (emerald-800). Replaces emerald-600/500 wherever they were text.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Logo deep green (sampled from the vector logo). Brand fills: PrimaryButton, active nav, end card, headers on the slip. White on it 10.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo gold. Fills, marks and chart bars only; never text on light (2.3:1). On brand-green it reads 4.7:1 (bold/large only).

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Selected / primary fills: PrimaryButton, active nav, selected chips, plan bars, the hero slot. Light = brand-green; dark = mint so the fill stays visible on dark glass (brand-green on dark glass is about 1.4:1).

tokens.name: on-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill-strong: 10.9:1 light, 10.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-family TEXT (prices highlight, "advance" amounts) on glass-fill-strong.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Decorative glass ONLY (no text): frames, the sidebar rail behind nav items, photo tint plates. Any panel holding text uses glass-fill-strong.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Every panel, card, input, sheet and popover that holds text (90%). Dark: dark glass over the darkened photo.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline on glass panels. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: glass-border-strong
tokens.usage: Inner panels and dividers on glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every control. ≥6.6:1 on light glass, ≥10:1 on dark glass (3:1 required).

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay on rice-field-hero inside the app: white 20% light, emerald-950 60% dark.

tokens.name: photo-scrim-auth
tokens.usage: Login and cover overlay: emerald-950 40%, plus a black 0→60% vertical fade.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed steps in DeliveryStatusStepper (green-500) with black numerals (9.2:1).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success word/number text on glass-fill-strong (was #16a34a). Light measured value in the contrast table; dark #4ade80.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / awaiting status fills (yellow-400), with black or yellow-800 text.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning word text on glass-fill-strong.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info / in-transit chip FILL with black text and an icon (13.9:1). Never text on white (1.6:1). Value as edited on Karl's page; Karl's note said blue-600.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: DangerButton fill (rose-600); white on it is 4.7:1.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Danger chip and DangerButton fill with white text (8.0:1). Its luminance is 0.08 vs success 0.41: success and danger differ in lightness (3.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger / error word text on glass-fill-strong (InputError, decline reasons).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Kept for Karl's code paths. New text uses danger-ink (on glass red-600 measured below 4.5:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Solid white: text on brand-green / emerald-900 / emerald-950 / danger-strong fills; slip paper.

tokens.name: emerald-950
tokens.usage: Primary heading ink (text-emerald-950 on page titles, inputs) and the active NavLink fill; white on it is 15.2:1.

tokens.name: emerald-900
tokens.usage: Brand fill: btn-2026 / PrimaryButton background (#064e3b in app.css); white text on it is 9.7:1.

tokens.name: emerald-800
tokens.usage: Tint source for shadows and the dot-grid background pattern (#065f46 at 3–5%).

tokens.name: emerald-700
tokens.usage: Secondary accent text in module pages.

tokens.name: emerald-600
tokens.usage: Fills, icons, indicator bars, selected-option fill ONLY. Never text (3.8:1). Text accents use text-accent.

tokens.name: emerald-500
tokens.usage: Fills and the focus-border tint only. Never text (2.5:1).

tokens.name: emerald-400
tokens.usage: Active NavLink indicator bar with its glow.

tokens.name: emerald-200
tokens.usage: Text selection background (with emerald-900 text).

tokens.name: emerald-100
tokens.usage: Soft chips and borders on cards.

tokens.name: emerald-50
tokens.usage: Hover fill for NavLink and list items; first radial stop of lush-gradient.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Second radial stop of lush-gradient.

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: End stop of lush-gradient's vertical fade.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: RETIRED for text (2.4:1). Kept only so Karl's source maps; use text-muted. Allowed for disabled-state glyph tint and decorative rules.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: The RICE half of the wordmark and section titles in module pages.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: RETIRED for readable text (2.5:1). Decorative dividers and disabled outlines only; text uses text-secondary.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: RETIRED for readable text (1.5:1). Inactive stepper outlines only.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Inactive step border in DeliveryStatusStepper.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Clear/destructive hover glyphs and inline validation captions (rose-500).

tokens.name: admin-red
tokens.usage: Admin table header text (red-800) over a 10% tint of itself; 8.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Hard logistics style (all Haul screens): 4px black borders, shadow-hard offsets, black numerals and text on success/warning/info fills.

tokens.name: terrace-1
tokens.usage: Empty states / end card only: back paddy terrace layer.

tokens.name: terrace-2
tokens.usage: Empty states / end card only: middle terrace layer.

tokens.name: terrace-3
tokens.usage: Empty states / end card only: front terrace layer.

tokens.name: slip-ink
tokens.usage: SettlementSlip: everything prints pure black on white paper (black-and-white safe).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles in module dashboards: text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none, emerald-950.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Auth-screen title: text-3xl font-extrabold italic uppercase tracking-tighter.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and section titles: text-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Retired with the stacked RICE/CONNECT lockup; ApplicationLogo now renders the vector logo.

styles.name: slip-amount
styles.usage: Net amount on the SettlementSlip; tabular figures, slip-ink.

styles.name: body-phone
styles.usage: Running text on phone screens (16px minimum).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines (sentence case). 12px is the floor for any text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: All buttons, uppercase via CSS. Was 11px / 0.2em. Buttons size to their label (no fixed widths: TL/HIL run 30–40% longer).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and table headers, uppercase via CSS; text-muted. Was 10px / 0.3em.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows above titles, uppercase; text-muted. Was 9px / 0.5em text-faint.

type.note: Plus Jakarta Sans tops out at 800 on Google Fonts (a 900 request returns HTTP 400), so every former 900 is 800.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale; these are the steps the components use.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between logo mark and wordmark; small icon padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap (mb-3); gap inside NavLink.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Secondary/Danger button vertical padding (py-4); header gap; list item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Input padding (p-5) and primary button vertical padding (py-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: NavLink and dropdown-list horizontal padding (px-6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Secondary/Danger button horizontal padding (px-8); sidebar gutters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Primary button horizontal padding (px-10); auth card inner padding (p-10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space under a glass-header (mb-12) and between auth blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown panel (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Logo mark tile, modal panel (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Small icon buttons inside inputs (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: icon-box tiles and list options (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-nav
tokens.usage: NavLink (rounded-[1.5rem]).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and the MunicipalitySelect popover (rounded-[2rem]).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Inner auth panel (rounded-[3rem]).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: glass-card (rounded-[3.5rem]).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, status dots, indicator bars.

shadow.note: Soft emerald-tinted lifts for the glass style; one hard offset shadow for the logistics style.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: glass-2026 panels.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: glass-card.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: MunicipalitySelect list and floating panels.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: PrimaryButton at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: PrimaryButton on hover, together with a 4px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-nav-active
tokens.usage: Active NavLink.

tokens.name: shadow-danger
tokens.usage: DangerButton at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-glow
tokens.usage: glass-header-icon bar.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Logistics hard style: completed stepper circles, transport cards.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring as a shadow (2px offset + 3px focus-ring) for pills where outline radius lags.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: glass-2026 and glass-card (backdrop-blur-[12px]).

tokens.name: blur-input
tokens.usage: input-2026 fields.

tokens.name: blur-heavy
tokens.usage: Sidebar, popovers and auth inner panel (backdrop-blur-3xl).
